Single · game Model a distribution of team scores from prior team performance, availability and home/away; derive win, spread and total probabilities. Point-in-time inputs, historical executable prices and settlement rules. Unvalidated Context / source ↗

Single · player prop Model volume and efficiency conditional on expected participation; price the full outcome distribution, including push and void cases. Official player game statistics, availability timestamps and prop quotes. Unvalidated Context / source ↗

Parlay · different games Estimate joint win probability; compare with actual offered payout rather than assuming independence. Paired outcomes, concurrent quotes and joint out-of-sample calibration. Unvalidated Context / source ↗

Combo · same game props Jointly simulate shared game and player usage; estimate joint outcomes and settlement. Paired player-game data, injury/void rules and actual combo prices. Unvalidated Context / source ↗
